mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_jobs, COALESCE(SUM(total_slots), 0) as total_slots, COALESCE(SUM(filled_slots), 0) as filled_slots FROM job_demands WHERE is_active = true AND (deadline IS NULL OR deadline >= CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_self_candidates, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_self_candidates, SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inactive_self_candidates, SUM(CASE WHEN profile_complete = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as complete_profile_self_candidates FROM candidates WHERE candidate_type = #{candidateType}

SELECT COUNT(u.id) as total_agencies, SUM(CASE WHEN u.approval_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_agencies, SUM(CASE WHEN u.approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approved_agencies, SUM(CASE WHEN u.approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rejected_agencies FROM users u INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.role = #{role}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM job_demands WHERE is_active = true AND (deadline IS NULL OR deadline >= CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY status

SELECT jd.id, jd.title, c.name as country, jd.total_slots, jd.filled_slots, jd.remaining_slots, jd.applied_count, jd.status, jd.created_at FROM job_demands jd LEFT JOIN countries c ON jd.country_id = c.id WHERE jd.is_active = true AND (jd.deadline IS NULL OR jd.deadline >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY jd.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT u.id, u.full_name, u.email, u.approval_status, u.created_at FROM users u INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.role = #{role} ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM job_demands WHERE created_at >= #{startDate} AND is_active = true AND (deadline IS NULL OR deadline >= CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date DESC

SELECT DATE(u.created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM users u INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.role = #{role} AND u.created_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(u.created_at) ORDER BY date DESC
